body:
## Summary
- fail closed when Host RSS readiness safety metadata says the probe installs/replaces the Host
- fail closed when Host RSS readiness safety metadata says it closes runtime gates
- preserve structured source paths and concrete validation errors in failed Host RSS gate reports
- fail fast before two-hour Host RSS collection when the required Host readiness JSON is missing
- update Host RSS readiness references and retest instructions

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_host_rss_gate tools.tests.test_real_device_gate tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_host_memory_diagnostic tools.tests.test_real_device_gate -v
- python3 -m py_compile tools/vibescreen_evidence/host_rss_gate.py tools/tests/test_host_rss_gate.py
- git diff --check
- make phase0-stable-release-gate
- make -n host-rss-gate EVIDENCE_DIR=.build/evidence HOST_RSS_HOST_READINESS_JSON=docs/changes/2026-08-10-host-rss-growth/evidence/2026-08-31-current-base-host-rss-failclosed-readiness/host-readiness.json
- make soak-2h-host-rss-gate EVIDENCE_SERIAL=mock HOST_PID=99999 EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/vibe-screen-missing-host-rss-readiness HOST_RSS_HOST_READINESS_JSON=/tmp/vibe-screen-missing-host-rss-readiness/missing-host-readiness.json (expected exit 2 before any soak starts)
- adb -s REDACTED_ANDROID_SERIAL reverse --list

## Not run
- Did not start Vibe Screen/MacHost/Telemachus GUI
- Did not run swift run
- Did not request or modify Screen Recording/Accessibility/Microphone/Keychain/TCC/System Settings
- Did not create adb reverse
title: test: harden Host RSS readiness safety checks
